environment_constraints: WSL path for the workspace is /mnt/c/Users/HARI/Downloads/flutter/edgemesh. C build runs in WSL only. Dashboard npm/npx runs in Windows PowerShell (cmd /c or PowerShell cd). Do NOT use SO_NOSIGPIPE (Linux lacks it) — use MSG_NOSIGNAL on send() calls. Use clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) for latency and CLOCK_REALTIME for timestamps. Requires _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L feature-test macro. GCC 15.2.0 enforces strict C17. No sigpipe: use sigaction(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN) in main.c OR MSG_NOSIGNAL per-send.
contribution_requirements: C17 standard, -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror. Check ALL socket/syscall returns. Never hold mutex during network I/O. Release in-flight reservations on ALL exit paths (goto cleanup). Bound all buffers (16KiB request headers, 4KiB admin body, 300 time-series points, 10000 latency samples). Safe JSON escaping. CORS: only http://localhost:5173 and http://127.0.0.1:5173. Bind both listeners to 127.0.0.1 only. MSG_NOSIGNAL on send(). results/ dir for benchmark output.
key_patterns: All shared headers go in include/edgemesh/. Modules are src/<module>/<name>.c with matching include/edgemesh/<name>.h. The proxy and admin API are separate accept loops in the same process connected via shared state. Backend pool is a fixed array of 3 structs protected by a single pthread_mutex_t. In-flight reservation: increment under lock before network I/O, decrement under lock on all exit paths. Use goto cleanup pattern inside proxy worker threads. Admin API endpoints map to: GET /api/v1/health, GET /api/v1/overview, GET /api/v1/backends, PUT /api/v1/policy, GET /api/v1/metrics, GET /api/v1/benchmarks/latest.
directory_structure: edgemesh/ — root with CMakeLists.txt, AGENTS.md, LICENSE, README.md, .gitignore; docs/ — four spec files; include/edgemesh/ — all .h headers; src/common/, src/http/, src/backend/, src/health/, src/metrics/, src/admin_api/, src/proxy/, src/demo_backend/ — C source modules; src/main.c — process entry point; benchmark/ — benchmark_client.c; tests/ — CTest test sources; results/ — runtime output (gitignored); dashboard/ — Vite react-ts app
